listings.remarks: Open Sunday August 9th 12p-2p. Move-in ready and beautifully refreshed, this turnkey home is tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Bethany's desirable neighborhoods, offering quick access to Hwy 26, Nike, Intel, and other major employers. Inside, you'll find a bright, welcoming interior featuring brand-new interior paint, plush new carpet, and stylish luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout. Designed with both comfort and flexibility in mind, the home offers three spacious bedrooms, 2.5 updated bathrooms, and two separate living areas that provide plenty of space to gather, entertain, or simply spread out. The updated kitchen is ready for everyday life with new quartz countertops, brand-new stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinet space. The bathrooms have been thoughtfully refreshed with modern vanities, creating clean, contemporary spaces throughout. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features an updated en-suite bath and a walk-in closet, creating a peaceful and private retreat at the end of the day. Step outside to a flat, fully usable backyard that offers plenty of room for entertaining, gardening, pets, or play. Whether you're hosting summer barbecues or simply enjoying the outdoors, this versatile space is ready for your vision. Major system upgrades provide exceptional peace of mind, including a furnace and central air conditioning system installed in 2025, along with a professionally refreshed crawl space. With extensive updates, flexible living spaces, low-maintenance appeal, and a prime cul-de-sac location with great access to parks, shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this home is truly move-in ready and ready for its next chapter.

Rate Promo for limited time! Move right into this beautifully finished Farmhouse Kruse floor plan! The open, light-filled main level features soaring 10-foot ceilings and a spacious kitchen with a large center island, creating the perfect space for entertaining and everyday living. The luxurious primary suite includes a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, a soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a generous walk-in closet. The finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility with an additional bedroom, home office, or bonus room, along with a full bathroom—ideal for guests, remote work, or extra living space. Thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes throughout, this move-in ready home combines style, comfort, and functionality. Photos shown are of the actual home. Contact us today for more information or to schedule your private tour!

Quick Move-In Opportunity with Limited-Time Special Rate Buydown!Discover this beautifully designed new construction Brookings floor plan in the heart of Bethany, offering a spacious open-concept layout and professionally selected designer finishes. Step inside to a welcoming foyer with a staircase leading to the main living level. The entry floor also features a private bedroom and full bathroom—ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office—along with an additional family room and convenient access to the attached two-car garage. The bright and airy main level is designed for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy a spacious kitchen with an oversized center island, walk-in pantry, and seamless flow into the dining and living areas. A dedicated office with French doors provides a quiet workspace. From the dining area, step outside to your patio and generously sized, professionally landscaped backyard measuring approximately 23' x 54'. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers a luxurious retreat with a dual-sink vanity, soaking tub, tile-walled shower, and spacious walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a conveniently located laundry room complete the upper level. Located just minutes from parks, trails, and Bethany Lake, this home offers easy access to Pirate Park, Rock Creek Trail, and nearby farms known for seasonal berry picking and pumpkin patches. Enjoy the convenience of Bethany Village Centre with its shopping, dining, summer concerts, and holiday events. Local favorites such as Piccolo Mondo Toy Store and Play Street Museum are nearby, while Forest Park, the Oregon Zoo, and downtown Portland attractions are just a short drive away. This home includes professionally selected designer upgrades and is ready for a quick move-in. Contact the sales team for complete details. The 3D tour showcases another home with the same floor plan; exterior and interior photos are of the actual home, professionally staged.

Welcome to this beautifully remodeled 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offering 2,131 square feet of stylish and functional living space in the heart of Beaverton/Aloha. Thoughtfully updated throughout, this move-in ready home combines modern finishes with a spacious layout designed for comfortable everyday living and entertaining.Step inside to discover bright, open living areas, updated flooring, refreshed kitchen and baths, and generous bedroom sizes that provide flexibility for guests, home offices, or multi-generational living. The kitchen features modern appliances, ample cabinetry, and seamless flow into the dining and living spaces. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers privacy and comfort, while additional bedrooms provide room for everyone. Outside, enjoy fresh new landscaping, great curb appeal, and a fully fenced backyard with patio space perfect for summer BBQs, pets, gardening, or relaxing evenings. Conveniently located near parks, schools, shopping, restaurants, and major commuter routes, this turnkey home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and accessibility. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own a beautifully updated home in a desirable Beaverton neighborhood!

Welcome to this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offering 2,267 square feet of beautifully designed living space on a private 0.17-acre lot in the highly sought-after Burntwood West neighborhood.Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features formal living and dining rooms, including a wood-burning fireplace in the formal living room, a bright kitchen with breakfast nook, and an inviting family room with a gas stove that opens to an expansive deck overlooking the private, terraced backyard.The spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet, dual vanity, soaking tub, and separate shower, while three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or hobbies.Recent improvements include a new 50-year roof, new concrete driveway, quartz countertops, newer high-efficiency furnace and central air conditioning, Fibrex replacement windows, LeafGuard gutters, fresh exterior trim paint, refreshed landscaping, and annual professional maintenance of the HVAC, fireplace, and plumbing systems.Located just blocks from Tallac Terrace Park and conveniently near Nike, Intel, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. This move-in ready home is served by Cooper Mountain Elementary and Mountainside High School and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and lasting value.

Price Reduced! Built in 2023 and presenting as new, this refined residence pairs a luxurious open-concept great room and designer kitchen, expansive island, sleek stainless appliances, and abundant cabinetry, with a contemporary fireplace and large windows that capture a lovely valley view. A gracious covered front patio sets a welcoming tone for sunrise coffee, while the thoughtful five-bedroom plan includes a lower-level guest suite with walk-in closet and full bath, ideal for visitors or multi-generational living. The upstairs primary retreat features a spa-inspired bath with oversized soaking tub, walk-in shower, and double-sink vanity. Outdoor living excels with a newly added, expansive paver patio crowned by a stylish pavilion with ambient lighting for year-round alfresco dining and relaxing. Quality finishes, modern systems, generous storage, and a versatile 3-car garage with organization and fitness potential elevate everyday comfort. The home’s calm, neutral palette and abundant natural light create an effortlessly polished atmosphere. At the same time, this home is close to major employers including Intel and Nike, parks, shopping and daily conveniences. Special Financing Incentives available on this property from SIRVA Mortgage.

Open House Saturday 11-1PM! Thoughtfully redesigned from top to bottom, this mid-century modern home in Beaverton’s coveted Royal Woodlands neighborhood blends timeless architecture with a full contemporaryrenovation, offering five bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and generous indoor–outdoor living spaces. Set on a quiet, tree-lined street in Royal Woodlands, the home showcases classic mid-centurylines, with a welcoming front elevation, large windows, and clean architectural details that highlight its 1960s origin. An inviting front porch offers plenty of room to sit and catch up with friends and sets the tone for the home’s emphasis on comfort and connection. This beautiful home delivers exceptional value for buyers seeking a turnkey property with high-end finishes and a flexible floor plan that can adapt to a variety of lifestyles. Inside, the main level features a spacious, open floor plan with an easy flow between living, dining, and entertaining spaces, ideal for gatherings and everyday living. A brick fireplace anchors the living room, adding warmth and character, while large windows draw in natural light and provide views of the surrounding greenery. The custom designed kitchen has been fully remodeled with high-end appliances and modern finishes that complement the home’s mid-century aesthetic. The main level includes the primary bedroom plus two additional bedrooms, making single-level living highly functional. The fully remodeled lower level expands the usable square footage and adds tremendous versatility, with additional bedrooms and a living space that can serve as a guest suite, media room, playroom, or a fitness area. A completely renovated, spa-like bathroom offers a luxurious experience, featuring modern fixtures and finishes designed to create a relaxing, retreat-style atmosphere. The home has a brand new roof, new large deck and extensive renovations throughout the interior.

Living in Bull Mountain offers a unique blend of convenience, community, and natural beauty. Perched above the valley with access to scenic trails, neighborhood parks, and some of the area's most popular shopping and dining destinations, this sought-after Tigard neighborhood is known for its welcoming atmosphere and easy access to everything the Portland metro area has to offer. Nestled on a quiet residential street, this corner lot Craftsman is a beautifully maintained and extensively updated home that combines modern improvements with the warmth and comfort of everyday living. From the moment you arrive, the home feels inviting and exceptionally well cared for. Fresh exterior paint, completed in 2026, enhances the home's timeless appeal. Inside, new luxury flooring and carpet installed throughout the entire home in 2024, along with fresh interior paint throughout the home and garage, create bright, cohesive spaces that are truly move-in ready. Beyond cosmetic updates, significant investments have been made to provide long-term peace of mind: A new Malarkey 50-year roof, gutters, and downspouts were installed in 2025, followed by a new high-efficiency furnace and central air conditioning system. A Universal CPH50 EV charger was added and approved through PGE+, offering modern convenience. Step outside to discover the fully fenced backyard offering space to gather, garden, and play. The covered patio creates a perfect setting for outdoor dining and summer barbecues, while mature landscaping, a charming apple tree, and a dedicated tool shed add beauty and functionality. Ideally located just minutes from Progress Ridge, Washington Square, neighborhood parks, walking trails, grocery stores, restaurants, and major commuter routes, this home delivers the lifestyle that makes Bull Mountain so desirable. This is a place where everyday moments feel a little more special and where new memories are ready to be made.

Welcome to this stunning Mediterranean-inspired home located in the highly desirable Village at Orenco community. This spacious 4-bedroom residence offers thoughtful design, modern upgrades, and exceptional living spaces perfectly suited for today’s lifestyle.Step inside through a dramatic vaulted entryway filled with natural light, creating an inviting first impression. The main level features a versatile den/office, ideal for remote work, study, or guest use.The remodeled kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and freshly painted white cabinetry. It flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, making it perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Recent updates include newer flooring, brand-new carpet, and fresh interior paint, giving the home a bright, clean, move-in-ready feel.Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features soaring ceilings and a peaceful retreat atmosphere. Generously sized secondary bedrooms and a large bonus room provide flexibility for a media room, playroom, or additional workspace.Enjoy outdoor living in the fully finished backyard with elegant pavers — a low-maintenance space ideal for entertaining, dining, or relaxing evenings outdoors.Conveniently located near parks, shopping, dining, and major employers, this home combines style, comfort, and convenience in one of Hillsboro’s most sought-after neighborhoods.
